purpose: SC3 and SC5 end to end on the local Compose stack: the 72 holdout texts submitted through the API gateway as participants, measured from submission to stored outcome in Reports (spec 234). Not an offline quality score: the offline gate of these cases is in runs/2026-11-20-holdout-v8.
status: frozen part committed before the first measured submission (8188e0e); results added after the runs

commands.stack: FAROL_AI_URL=http://ai:11434 docker compose -p farol-234 -f infra/compose.yaml --env-file infra/.env.example --profile ai up -d --wait --wait-timeout 600 (images built from this branch with docker build -t farol-<service>:dev backend/<service>, and frontend)
commands.model: the farol-234_ai-models volume is a copy of the #224 model volume (qwen3:4b); ollama list shows the digest below; Reports' warm-up loads it at start-up, and the run starts once ollama ps shows it loaded
commands.sc5: docker compose -p farol-234 ... stop ai, then python -I Docs/Research/architecture-investigation/evaluation/e2e_triage.py --run sc5 --out Docs/Research/architecture-investigation/evaluation/runs/2026-11-21-e2e (FAROL_AI_URL still set)
commands.memory: docker compose -p farol-234 ... exec ai cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak after the SC3 run (cgroup v2; the container started fresh with the stack)

profile_note: Proposed, for the team's review (spec 234 D1): NFR-03 and the runtime contract state no arrival rate. One request every 30 s on a fixed schedule (open model), 72 requests, 36 minutes per run. Participants Rita, Sofia, Inês and Nuno in turn (each every 2 minutes); Miguel, in a Control room team with HelpRequests.Triage, polls the list and the triage status every 2 s. Logins happen before the first submission; access tokens are renewed with their refresh token.

pass_rules.sc3: Pass when the valid suggestions stored within 30 s are at least 95 % of the 66 non-abstention cases (ADR-005 offline definition). Valid: state Suggested with a category and a priority stored at most 30 000 ms after submission, both times Reports' own (help_request.submitted_at, triage_suggestion.updated_at). A request still Pending with no reason after its deadline is a Timeout; abstentions, errors, invalid and late outputs are misses. Reported beside it, not part of the pass: the NFR-03 count over all 72 (expected abstentions are misses there), p50, p95 (nearest rank) and max of the end-to-end time of the stored suggestions, fallbacks by reason, the worker's model time.
pass_rules.sc5: Pass when every one of the 72 requests appears in the operator's list and reads NotTriaged with a reason at a poll no later than 32 000 ms after it was sent (30 s deadline plus one 2 s poll), and no poll shows them out of order of arrival.

fixture: Reports' local copies hold one new event per run: a team 'Control room' (HelpRequests.Triage) and five RegularUser memberships, written with SQL as MembershipChanged and TeamChanged would write them (US-12 and US-18 answer 501 in Auth & Users; Events publishes no TeamChanged yet). Spec 234 D2.

stack.docker: Docker Desktop, engine 28.4.0, VM with 12 CPUs and 8 167 571 456 bytes of memory, on the 16 GiB laptop of #224

runtime.name: Ollama, Compose service ai (profile ai)
runtime.inference: CPU only (no GPU passed to the container)

model.name: qwen3:4b
model.source: ollama list in the container (ID 359d7dd4bcda) and the #224 manifest

settings: Reports' OllamaTriageModel, spec US-34 D2: POST /api/chat, stream false, think false, schema in format, temperature 0, seed 42, num_ctx 4096, num_predict 256, keep_alive 10m; connect 2 s, one attempt, at most 20 s and the time left before the 30 s deadline; admission only with at least 23 s left; circuit J1 (spec US-36 D1)

sc3.result: FAILED: 61 of 66 non-abstention cases valid within 30 s (0.924, target 0.95); 61 of 72 under the NFR-03 count (0.847). Misses: 4 Timeout (H020, H035, H066, H067: the model call reached its 20 s cap) and 1 Unavailable (H069: the circuit opened after H066 and H067 timed out and H068 was slow, and closed 56 s later); the 6 expected abstentions abstained.

system_overhead_ms.definition: e2e_ms minus worker_ms of the 61 stored suggestions: outbox, broker, worker queue and storage

sc3.model_time_note: worker_ms median 13.6 s on the stack against a provider_ms median of 11.7 s for the same 72 cases in runs/2026-11-20-holdout-v8 run 1 (direct calls, no other container busy); 18 of 72 calls over the 16 s slow threshold (1 in the offline run).
sc3.agreement_with_offline: each of the 61 stored suggestions has the category and priority of runs/2026-11-20-holdout-v8 run 1 for the same case (same model, prompt v8, settings and seed)
sc3.circuit: triage-status read unavailable from 2028 s to 2084 s after the start (sc3-status.jsonl)
sc3.memory_note: cgroup memory.peak of the ai container after the SC3 run; it covers the whole life of the container (Reports warm-up, both trial runs and SC3), including the page cache of the mapped model file. docker stats after the run: 3.39 GiB.

sc5.result: PASSED: 72 of 72 shown in the operator list (first poll after the submission, at most 86 ms), 72 of 72 read NotTriaged with a reason at most 4.0 s after they were sent (37 ProviderError, the circuit then letting one probe through every 30 s, and 35 Unavailable without a call), no poll out of order of arrival.
sc5.ai_container: stopped with docker compose stop ai before the run; FAROL_AI_URL still http://ai:11434
sc5.status_note: triage-status read available at the start (the circuit was closed and nothing had failed yet) and unavailable (ProviderError) from 32 s to the end (sc5-status.jsonl).

trial_note: Before the freeze, two trial runs of three synthetic texts (not holdout cases, driver option --trial) checked the stack and the driver in other events; the first showed that a Keycloak login takes about 6 s and blocked the operator polls, so logins moved before the first submission and tokens are renewed with their refresh token (driver commit above).
